news.title: The hidden silver lining of high interest rates: safer, cheaper retirement income
news.description: Annuity payout rates are closely tied to interest rates
news.author: Mark Hulbert

copy.hook: Why do high rates make retirement paychecks bigger?
copy.explain: An annuity (lifetime paycheck plan) puts your lump sum into bonds. When bonds pay more interest, the insurer can promise you a bigger monthly check.
copy.takeaway: When rates rise, each saved dollar buys more future income.
copy.question: Would you swap a lump sum for a lifetime monthly check at today's rates?
